questions.q: What does a report subscription do that running a report manually doesn't?
options: It changes the report's underlying data
It delivers refreshed results by email automatically, on a schedule
It permanently exports the report to a folder
It converts the report into a dashboard
questions.explain: A subscription automates delivery: the report runs and emails results on the schedule you set, with no manual step required after setup.

questions.q: Who can be added as a recipient to a report subscription?
options: Anyone with a Salesforce license, regardless of report access
Only the person who created the subscription
Only users, groups, or roles that already have permission to access the report
Any external email address, Salesforce user or not
questions.explain: Only users, groups, or roles with existing access to the report are valid matches when adding recipients — subscriptions can't be used to bypass sharing rules.

questions.q: What does the "Run Report As: Another Person" setting control?
options: Who receives the subscription email
Whose data-level access the delivered report results reflect
How often the report is scheduled to run
Whether the report is attached as a file
questions.explain: Run Report As decides whose record-level access produces the results. Choosing another person means recipients see what that person would see — which may be more or less than they'd normally access.

questions.q: What do conditions on a report subscription accomplish?
options: They filter which fields appear in the exported file
They determine which users can edit the report
They decide how the report is grouped and summarized
They turn the subscription into an alert that only sends when all conditions are met
questions.explain: Up to five conditions can be attached to a subscription. The report is only emailed on a given run if every condition evaluates true — otherwise nothing is sent.

questions.q: A subscription has Attach File set to Formatted Report. What does a recipient receive?
options: A .csx details-only file
An .xlsx file they can open without logging into Salesforce
A live link that requires Salesforce login to view
Nothing; Attach File only applies to dashboards
questions.explain: Formatted Report delivers an .xlsx attachment. Report Details (.csx) is the alternative, details-only format — both let the recipient open the file without logging in.
